data.one_liner: Simple Flutter clustering library for Google Maps based on Geohash.
data.what_it_does: Clusters items on a Google Maps widget using Geohash to maintain performance when rendering a large number of markers. It allows customized cluster icons, zoom level configuration, and dynamic updates of map items.
use_when: You are using Google Maps in Flutter and need to display many marker items efficiently
You want to group nearby markers into clusters based on zoom levels
avoid_when: you are not using Google Maps
you are using an alternative map solution like flutter_map
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web
Allows configuring zoom levels and extra bounds padding
weaknesses: Tied specifically to Google Maps platform interfaces
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and initializing a ClusterManager instance once the map controller is created.
